name: Surveillance detection
description: The adversary might leverage surveillance detection techniques if they suspect themselves targeted by physical surveillance.

subtechniques.name: Camera detector
subtechniques.description: Camera detectors might be used to detect infrared radiation coming from objects, for example in hotel rooms.

subtechniques.name: Metal detector
subtechniques.description: Metal detectors might be used in hotels, Airbnb’s and so on to detect equipment.

subtechniques.name: Pin-pointer
subtechniques.description: Pin pointers might be used in hotels, Airbnb’s and so on to detect equipment.
